governingQuestion: Who may enter Milano Fashion Week—and who may claim its name?

beats.direction: Use the recurring witness with an on-screen disclaimer: CITY CONTEXT / NOT DAY-SPECIFIC.
beats.voice: Milan joins inherited house authority to contemporary systems of staging, craft, platform distribution, wholesale and traceability. This chapter follows access: The decisive technology is not the door but the stack of schedule, accreditation, invitation and identity checks that precedes it.
beats.onScreen: Then: CNMI describes itself as coordinating Italian fashion and publishes the official calendar; its live notice states events are invitation-only and that CNMI owns the Milano Fashion Week trademark.

That earlier record fixes a point in time; it does not prove an inevitable progression toward the present.
beats.onScreen: Now: Accreditation, calendar, app and organizer brand control form one public access layer, but invitations remain issued by individual event hosts.
